name: Hertfordshire Environmental Improvement Grant
summary: Small grants from Hertfordshire County Council's Countryside Management Service for nature improvement projects such as meadow restoration, woodland and hedgerow work, and new ponds, wetlands or reedbeds. Usually pays 50% of agreed costs.

eligibility.rule: Not work required by planning conditions or legal duties; suits local ecology, landscape and archaeology

applicant_types.quote: Community-based organisations and private landowners or land managers can apply for up to £3,000 in funding for nature improvement projects.

geography.quote: enhance nature in Hertfordshire by 20% by 2050

access.quote: Contact us to discuss your application before you submit it.

amount.quote: Community-based organisations and private landowners or land managers can apply for up to £3,000 in funding for nature improvement projects.

effort.quote: Contact us to discuss your application before you submit it.
Once we've confirmed that your application is eligible we'll send you a grant application form.

eligibility.quote: We cannot fund projects that: require planning conditions to be met have statutory duty or other legal/contractual obligations are not appropriate to the ecology, landscape and archaeology of the area.
